description: P0.3: half_twice and dragon_first_double both active on the same Dragon-type attacker. Proves sequential (not nested/recursive) ordering -- half_twice's extra hit runs and mutates target HP FIRST, then dragon_first_double's own guard re-checks target.current_hp/mover.current_hp against that already-mutated state (bundle.deobfuscated.js: the half_twice block at 56220-56284 precedes the dragon_first_double block at 56285-56364, sequential ifs, not mutually exclusive) -- and that neither trait's own extra hit re-triggers itself or the other (BIO's post-hit subset never re-checks half_twice/dragon_first_double). Gen1 so ability_config/traits_config are both null.
